image_title: Identification through Database Search Flow Diagram
summary: This flow diagram illustrates the process of identifying records through a database search. It begins with 730 records identified through database search with queries and a recency filter. After removing duplicates, the count remains at 730. All records are screened, with 616 records excluded from the total. A total of 114 full-text articles are assessed for eligibility, resulting in 50 articles excluded for being irrelevant to the definition of an AI agent. Ultimately, 64 studies are included in the review.
